_note: warning: no autocomplete_message_task_on_send here, on purpose: this agent does the work itself, so a reply is not an answer. It must close each input task with task.update state:completed (the output_contract enforces it) or the 32-slot task store fills and the bot can chat but never act. The engine closes a task only when a run fails. Read docs/concepts/task-feature.md, 'Who closes an input task'.
